# check top-right HUD boxes and underline before/after clicking white box
def hud(f):
    seg=f.segmentation['nodes']
    out={}
    for n in seg:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if max(rs)<10 and min(cs)>30:  # top-right HUD region
            out[f"{n['color']}@{min(rs)},{min(cs)}"]=(max(rs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    return out
